title: Passive Limit Versus Cross Market Realized Entry-Cost Attribution

research_height.transfer_path: Entry-deal commission/fee and adverse slippage become lifecycle cost per planned R, then combine with filled and attempted-order net to distinguish order-cost service from signal weakness at the US100-book level.

central_question: In the exact P4 current-spec ledger, does Passive limit execution deliver a material recorded entry-cost advantage over same-symbol Cross market execution, and if so does Passive still deliver lower stressed value after including expired attempts?

research_bundle.name: recorded_entry_burden_fill_spread_context_and_attempt_denominator_falsification
lenses: mechanism: recorded entry commission/fee plus adverse slippage per planned R for Passive limit and Cross market fills
market context: fill-time quoted spread in bps, explicitly descriptive rather than claimed spread capture
falsification and transfer: filled-lifecycle stressed R plus Passive placed-order denominator including 27 unfilled expiries

idea_provenance.authority_note: The memo supplies the question and strong falsifier only. All economic authority and inputs remain inside Project Zeta Terminus Next.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 072 preserved US100 as a high-turnover, lower-yield positive-return sleeve. Before any component or capital interpretation, the recorded contribution of Passive's distinct limit order type must be separated from its signal economics.
why_now.connection_bridge: US100 uses 62.42% of binding fills for 17.26% of binding stressed net, and Passive is its only limit-order component. The frozen P4 research ledger now exposes entry cost fields and a natural same-symbol market-order control.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 072 was Program 5 macro cross-period book-role synthesis. Unit 073 moves to Program 3 micro entry-deal mechanics and meso order-type transfer on one exact current-spec P4 path.
why_now.decision_if_cost_advantage_and_lower_val: Attribute Passive's lower value to signal/path economics rather than recorded entry cost; preserve order type and retain no order implementation candidate.
why_now.decision_if_cost_disadvantage_and_lower_: Retain one later separately declared controlled same-signal market-versus-limit Lab question; do not change Passive or Live here.
why_now.decision_if_no_separation: Record that current entry-cost fields do not discriminate order type and cannot identify adverse selection; preserve current order construction.
why_now.decision_if_ambiguous_or_invalid: Record the exact observation gap and rotate away.

lifecycle_ledger.role: Birth cost fields and close stressed outcome.

candidate_ledger.role: Passive placed-order and Cross market-open attempt denominators only.

ledger_result.role: Frozen current-spec integrity, 356 positions and 90.2337 USD stressed-net anchor.

order_source.role: Semantic authority for entry transaction cost, spread and adverse-slippage fields.

premetric_topology.illustrative_schema_inspection: The CSV header and first Passive lifecycle were viewed to confirm field names and row roles; no component aggregate, comparator distribution, gate or verdict was calculated.

source_semantics.entry_transaction_cost: Sum of DEAL_COMMISSION, DEAL_SWAP and DEAL_FEE on DEAL_ENTRY_IN rows. Negative values are cost; positive values are not treated as negative cost.
source_semantics.entry_adverse_slippage: Nonnegative USD value from price beyond the contemporaneous executable ask for buys or bid for sells, times contract size and volume.
source_semantics.entry_spread_price: Volume-weighted contemporaneous ask-minus-bid in price units. It is quote context and does not prove spread paid or earned.
source_semantics.identifiability_limit: The ledgers do not retain placement-time executable bid/ask or midpoint for every Passive order and do not retain counterfactual returns for expiries. Therefore this unit cannot label adverse selection or literal spread capture from fill-time spread alone.

frozen_reconstruction.lifecycle_pairing: For each target component, require exactly one BIRTH and one CLOSE for the same nonzero position_identifier. Use BIRTH entry fields and CLOSE stressed_net_usd.
frozen_reconstruction.attempted_order_value: For Cross, sum stressed net divided by Cross POSITION_OPEN outcomes. For Passive, sum stressed net divided by all Passive PENDING_ORDER outcomes, so each expiry contributes zero realized net to the denominator.
frozen_reconstruction.summaries: For cost R, quoted spread bps and lifecycle stressed R report count, mean, median, p90 and positive share where meaningful. Use linear-interpolated quantiles with sorted index (n-1)*q.
frozen_reconstruction.no_imputation: Do not assign a fill price, entry cost or hypothetical P/L to any expired Passive order.

requirements: All four input byte/hash pins and declared schemas pass.
Reproduce 841 lifecycle rows, 356 BIRTH, 356 CLOSE, 129 peer rows, 4,043 candidate rows, 129 Cross births, 92 Passive births, 119 Passive pending-order outcomes and 27 inferred expiries.
Every target position has exactly one birth and close, positive finite entry price, volume and planned risk, finite cost/spread/slippage/outcome fields and no dropped record.
At least 95% of each target component's births have entry_cost_known=1.
Cross has at least 100 fills, Passive at least 70 fills and at least 100 placed orders.
At least one component has mean recorded entry burden of at least 0.0001R.
At least one component has a positive recorded-entry-burden share of at least 5%.
Cross mean cost R minus Passive mean cost R is at least 0.001R.
Passive mean cost R is at most 75% of Cross mean cost R.
Passive p90 cost R is no greater than Cross p90 cost R.
Passive mean cost R minus Cross mean cost R is at least 0.001R.
Passive mean cost R is at least 1.25 times Cross mean cost R.
Passive p90 cost R is no lower than Cross p90 cost R.
Cross mean lifecycle stressed R minus Passive mean lifecycle stressed R is at least 0.03R.
Passive stressed net per placed order is lower than Cross stressed net per market-open attempt.

fixed_verdict_rules.cost_advantage_signal: PASS_PASSIVE_RECORDED_COST_ADVANTAGE_BUT_LOWER_VALUE_SIGNAL_WEAKNESS_NO_ORDER_CHANGE when integrity, Passive cost advantage and lower value all pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.cost_disadvantage: PASS_PASSIVE_RECORDED_COST_DISADVANTAGE_RETAIN_ONE_CONTROLLED_ORDER_TYPE_QUESTION when integrity, Passive cost disadvantage and lower value all pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.nondiscriminating: NO_RECORDED_ORDER_TYPE_COST_SEPARATION_NO_ADVERSE_SELECTION_IDENTIFICATION when integrity passes and the cost recorder is noninformative or neither material cost-direction gate passes.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_ORDER_TYPE_ENTRY_COST_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity passes but another combination occurs.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_ORDER_TYPE_ENTRY_COST_NO_VERDICT when any immutable, topology, pairing, field or density condition fails.

decision_translation.cost_advantage_signal: Preserve Passive limit execution and record weaker signal/path economics; no removal or signal change.
decision_translation.cost_disadvantage: Retain one future controlled identical-signal order-type Lab question; no current implementation.
decision_translation.nondiscriminating: Preserve current order construction and record that existing fields cannot identify spread capture or adverse selection.
decision_translation.ambiguous_or_invalid: Preserve current construction and rotate away.
